name: button
title: Button
description: Action trigger with four visual variants (Primary / Tonal / Outline / Text), two shapes (Square / Round), four sizes (xs / sm / md / lg), leading & trailing icon slots, and an Icon-Only mode. Pressed maps to the native :active state; Disabled is the standard gray palette. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 36:1881 (Pantheon › Buttons).
